signInBody: Use the same account you use in the Qalta app.
emailSignInHint: Use the email and password linked to your Qalta account. To add or reset a password, sign in with Apple or Google first.
passwordSetupTitle: Set or change your Qalta password
passwordSetupBody: This adds email and password sign-in to your current account. Apple and Google will continue to work.
passwordUpdated: Password saved. You can use it with this email next time you sign in.
emailSignInFailed: Could not sign in with that email and password.
passwordUpdateFailed: Could not save the password. Sign in again and try once more.
consentBody: The agent will act on your behalf in your Qalta cloud spaces:
scopes: Read spaces, accounts, balances, categories, budgets, goals, transactions and recurring payments
Create and edit categories, budgets, goals and regular accounts
Add income, expenses and transfers, including batches of transactions
Create debt accounts and record lending, borrowing and repayments
Delete transactions, categories, budgets, goals and accounts only after a separate confirmation step
warning: Changes are real and sync to all your devices and members of shared spaces. Whether the agent asks before each change depends on the agent and its settings. You are responsible for what you let it do. Local-only spaces stay on your phone.
redirectHost: After approval the agent receives access at {host}. Check that you trust this app.
proRequired: AI agents need Qalta Pro with cloud spaces. Subscribe in the app, then connect again.
missing: This link is incomplete. Start connecting from your AI agent again.
signInFailed: Could not start sign-in. Try again.
